scope: Linux AMD64 source-declared candidates; not binary membership
limitations: This is a bounded source-declaration and notice inventory, not a binary SBOM. No release binary was downloaded, inspected or executed; no component is asserted linked merely because it appears here.

All unique source archive URLs in root/ext/pkg Zig manifests were inventoried; the zlib integration wrapper was followed one level. Selected h2o and urcrypt embedded libraries were inventoried. This is not an exhaustive recursive audit of every vendored file, auxiliary build script, example, submodule or toolchain.

Zig package hashes are transcribed verbatim, not recomputed. SHA256 values describe actually retrieved archive bytes or retained file bytes; tag/release URLs can move. Original Git commit pins are preserved where declared.

macOS SDK is explicitly excluded from AMD64 Linux and was not downloaded. NASM, sse2neon, optional Tracy and auxiliary/documentation components have separate scope labels and are not asserted shipped.

GNU GMP, GNU libsigsegv and libnatpmp were retrieved from primary release hosts instead of manifest mirrors; mirror-to-upstream archive equality is unverified. libsigsegv archive matches the independently supplied SHA256.
BLAKE3 vendored header reports 1.5.0 but differs from upstream 1.5.0. That version license is included as a clearly identified reference, not proof of vendored source identity or complete licensing.

Full found LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT texts are preserved. Where grants occur in headers, full original files are retained without execution. Some documentation/auxiliary terms and per-file attribution coverage remain unreviewed.

The known libsigsegv GPL-2.0-or-later and OpenSSL 1.1.1w original-terms distribution question remains unresolved. Notice collection provides no exception, compatibility determination, legal clearance, or complete corresponding-source offer.
Standard-library/toolchain/runtime-system components outside the declared source graph are not inventoried here. No Docker/build/runtime/lifecycle tests were performed.
